deepl-f3d7d2:EN:\u306F\u308B\u304B\u6614: Long ago, the beautiful land of Hyrule, surrounded by mountains and forests…
py-e5ad94ef:EN:\u2026\u3053\u3001\u3053\: …go with this sword and shield…keep pushing the dand, and keep building up the power in the sword.
py-e5ad94ef:EN:\uFF17\u8CE2\u8005\u306E\: The finder of the daughter of the seven sages shall be rewarded with 100 rupees.
py-e5ad94ef:EN:\u9053\u306B\u8FF7\u3063\: I'm lost on the road, I can see the X button PHS map... do you know...
py-e5ad94ef:EN:\u3042\u3063\u9B54\u6CD5\: Ah, the power of the magic is not enough... I can't use this item like this...
py-e5ad94ef:EN:\u30AC\u30F3\u30C6\u30E9\: I can light a fire with the Y button that gets the gantera in my hand…
py-e5ad94ef:EN:\u304D\u3044\u304F\u3001\: I’m going out for a bit. There’s nothing to worry about.
py-e5ad94ef:EN:\u57CE\u306B\u3084\u3063\: The priest Agahnim, who has come to the castle, is using a live sacrifice to reopen the seal of the Seven Sages.
py-e5ad94ef:EN:\u79C1\u306E\u540D\u524D\: My name is Zelda… 40 people were sacrificed, and I was the last one…
py-e5ad94ef:EN:\u305F\u3059\u3051\u3066\: I need help… I am being captured in the basement of the castle.
py-e5ad94ef:EN:\u3053\u3053\u306B\u5C01\: Here, there was the mysterious priest Aghanim, who plotted to dissolve the seal. He got the king out of his way, and...
py-e5ad94ef:EN:\u305D\u3057\u3066\u3001\: Then, the fateful time when Princess Zelda would be offered as a sacrifice, too, had already drawn that near.
py-e5ad94ef:EN:\u57CE\u306E\u5175\u9054\: Manipulating the castle's soldiers, he offered as sacrifices maidens descended from the Seven Sages, one after another.
py-e5ad94ef:EN:\u2026\u3057\u304B\u3057\: ....however, when those events had become legend...
py-e5ad94ef:EN:\u5C01\u5370\u306F\u3001\: The seal should never again have been undone.
py-e5ad94ef:EN:\u305D\u3053\u3067\u3001\: Thereupon, the country's king commanded Seven Sages and had the entrance to the sacred land sealed.
py-e5ad94ef:EN:\u3057\u304B\u3057\u3001\: However, there were none who returned. Worse, evil power came gushing forth from there.
py-e5ad94ef:EN:\u591A\u304F\u306E\u4EBA\: Many people fought, and vanished into the sacred land.

py-e5ad94ef:EN:\u5168\u77E5\u5168\u80FD\: It was said that somewhere in this region was gold possessing the powers of omnipotence and omniscience.
